quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a breakfast food flipped in the middle of cooking.
quests.question: Pancake
quests.hint: It's cooked flat on a hot griddle or pan.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Pancake is a breakfast food flipped in the middle of cooking.
quests.funFact: Some families shape a stack like a snowman just for fun!

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is a single-serving baked good, perfect for breakfast on the go?
quests.question: Muffin
quests.hint: It's a quick breakfast treat you can eat with one hand.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Muffin is a single-serving baked good, perfect for breakfast on the go.
quests.funFact: Tiny mini versions of this treat are a popular size for little hands!

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is a warm breakfast often topped with fruit or a little honey.
quests.question: Oatmeal
quests.hint: It's made by cooking oats slowly in milk or water.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Oatmeal is a warm breakfast often topped with fruit or a little honey.
quests.funFact: Oats used to be grown mainly to feed horses, not people!

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is a meal often eaten quickly during a school or work break.
quests.question: Lunch
quests.hint: It's often a shorter meal than the one at night.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lunch is a meal often eaten quickly during a school or work break.
quests.funFact: Many schools ring a bell to let students know it's time for this meal!

quests.instruction: Which one is the last main meal of the day, often eaten together?
quests.question: Dinner
quests.hint: It happens after the sun has gone down.
quests.explanation: That's right! Dinner is the last main meal of the day, often eaten together.
quests.funFact: Many families use this meal as a time to talk about their day!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a sweet syrupy food made inside a beehive.
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: It's thick, golden, and drizzled over warm toast.
quests.explanation: Great job! Honey is a sweet syrupy food made inside a beehive.
quests.funFact: Its color and flavor change depending on which flowers the bees visit!

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is crunchy little pieces of grain eaten with cold milk?
quests.question: Cereal
quests.hint: It gets poured straight from a box into a bowl.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cereal is crunchy little pieces of grain eaten with cold milk.
quests.funFact: It's often made from grains like corn, wheat, oats, or rice!

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is an evening meal that often has more courses than lunch?
quests.question: Dinner
quests.hint: It's often the biggest meal of the whole day.
quests.explanation: Well done! Dinner is an evening meal that often has more courses than lunch.
quests.funFact: In some countries, this meal is eaten very late at night!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a sweet golden liquid made by bees.
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: Buzzing insects make this sweet liquid in a hive.
quests.explanation: Correct! Honey is a sweet golden liquid made by bees.
quests.funFact: This food never spoils, even after hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a round breakfast food that puffs up with bubbles as it cooks.
quests.question: Pancake
quests.hint: It's soft, round, and perfect with butter on top.
quests.explanation: Super! Pancake is a round breakfast food that puffs up with bubbles as it cooks.
quests.funFact: This food is enjoyed for breakfast in countries all over the world!

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is the meal that comes before both lunch and dinner?
quests.question: Breakfast
quests.hint: It's the meal that starts your whole day.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Breakfast is the meal that comes before both lunch and dinner.
quests.funFact: This meal's name means to end the long 'fast' of sleeping all night!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a soft bread-like treat baked in its own paper cup?
quests.question: Muffin
quests.hint: It's soft, slightly sweet, and perfect for breakfast.
quests.explanation: You found it! Muffin is a soft bread-like treat baked in its own paper cup.
quests.funFact: Bakeries make these in flavors like blueberry, banana, and chocolate chip!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a warm, hearty bowl of cooked grains eaten in the morning.
quests.question: Oatmeal
quests.hint: It's often topped with banana slices or a little honey.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Oatmeal is a warm, hearty bowl of cooked grains eaten in the morning.
quests.funFact: It can be cooked in just a few minutes on the stove!

quests.instruction: Which one is the meal often packed in a lunchbox for school?
quests.question: Lunch
quests.hint: Many kids carry this meal to school in a special box.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Lunch is the meal often packed in a lunchbox for school.
quests.funFact: Sandwiches are one of the most popular choices for this meal!

quests.instruction: Which one is a crunchy breakfast food cooked between two hot metal plates?
quests.question: Waffle
quests.hint: It's golden, crunchy, and great with syrup and berries.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Waffle is a crunchy breakfast food cooked between two hot metal plates.
quests.funFact: The pattern helps hold extra syrup in every little square!

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is a bakery treat with a bumpy golden top.
quests.question: Muffin
quests.hint: Its top is bumpy and golden brown.
quests.explanation: Yes! Muffin is a bakery treat with a bumpy golden top.
quests.funFact: The bumpy top happens because the batter rises fast in a hot oven!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a small food, not a full meal, eaten to hold you over.
quests.question: Snack
quests.hint: It holds you over until the next big meal.
quests.explanation: That's right! Snack is a small food, not a full meal, eaten to hold you over.
quests.funFact: Many kids around the world enjoy this in the afternoon after school!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a golden breakfast food with a pattern perfect for holding syrup.
quests.question: Waffle
quests.hint: A special kitchen iron gives it its shape.
quests.explanation: Great job! Waffle is a golden breakfast food with a pattern perfect for holding syrup.
quests.funFact: A special kitchen tool with two hot plates is used to cook this food!

quests.instruction: Which one is a crispy breakfast food with a checkered, square pattern?
quests.question: Waffle
quests.hint: It's cooked between two hot plates that press a pattern into it.
quests.explanation: You got it! Waffle is a crispy breakfast food with a checkered, square pattern.
quests.funFact: This crispy treat is a favorite breakfast in many countries around the world!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is the meal eaten after the sun goes down?
quests.question: Dinner
quests.hint: This meal often has more than one course.
quests.explanation: Well done! Dinner is the meal eaten after the sun goes down.
quests.funFact: Long ago, this was often the only big cooked meal of the whole day!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a thick golden liquid stored in a jar shaped like a bear.
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: It's a natural sweetener, not a sugary candy.
quests.explanation: Correct! Honey is a thick golden liquid stored in a jar shaped like a bear.
quests.funFact: Bees have to visit thousands of flowers just to make a little bit!

quests.instruction: Which food is the meal many people eat with juice or milk in the morning?
quests.question: Breakfast
quests.hint: You eat it before both of the other main meals.
quests.explanation: Super! Breakfast is the meal many people eat with juice or milk in the morning.
quests.funFact: Many doctors say this is the most important meal of the day!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a flat round breakfast food stacked and topped with syrup.
quests.question: Pancake
quests.hint: It gets flipped over halfway through cooking.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Pancake is a flat round breakfast food stacked and topped with syrup.
quests.funFact: People flip these using just a quick snap of the wrist!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a sweet liquid bees make from flower nectar?
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: Its jar is sometimes shaped like a friendly bear.
quests.explanation: You found it! Honey is a sweet liquid bees make from flower nectar.
quests.funFact: Its color and flavor change depending on which flowers the bees visit!

quests.instruction: Which one is a fluffy flat food often topped with butter and syrup?
quests.question: Pancake
quests.hint: Several of them are often stacked on one plate.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Pancake is a fluffy flat food often topped with butter and syrup.
quests.funFact: Some families shape a stack like a snowman just for fun!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a breakfast food that turns milk sweet and tasty.
quests.question: Cereal
quests.hint: It comes in shapes like rings, flakes, or squares.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Cereal is a breakfast food that turns milk sweet and tasty.
quests.funFact: This food was first made as a healthy breakfast over 100 years ago!

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is a sticky sweet spread made from cooked, mashed fruit.
quests.question: Jam
quests.hint: It's often spread on toast alongside peanut butter.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Jam is a sticky sweet spread made from cooked, mashed fruit.
quests.funFact: Almost any fruit, from strawberries to grapes, can be made into this spread!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a crunchy breakfast food poured from a box into a bowl?
quests.question: Cereal
quests.hint: Cold milk is poured right over the top of it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Cereal is a crunchy breakfast food poured from a box into a bowl.
quests.funFact: Some kinds turn the milk a fun color, like chocolatey brown!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a quick bite that keeps you going until the next meal?
quests.question: Snack
quests.hint: Crackers, fruit, or popcorn are common choices for this.
quests.explanation: That's right! Snack is a quick bite that keeps you going until the next meal.
quests.funFact: A piece of fruit can make a healthy choice for this!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a soft round food cooked on a hot griddle until bubbly?
quests.question: Pancake
quests.hint: Maple syrup is often poured all over the stack.
quests.explanation: Great job! Pancake is a soft round food cooked on a hot griddle until bubbly.
quests.funFact: This food is enjoyed for breakfast in countries all over the world!
